original.target_description: Experiment 1a: high versus low goal conflict on log-transformed time spent browsing books, framed as work; simple effect in the 2 × 2 goal-conflict × activity-frame ANOVA (manuscript p. 16).

n.sample_role: Participants in the final Experiment 1a factorial ANOVA, from which the target simple effect is reported; model N across both activity frames, not a frame-specific subgroup count.
n.exclusions: 18 attention-check failures excluded from 228 recruited U.S. Amazon Mechanical Turk participants. No further target-model exclusions stated.
n.location: Accepted manuscript p. 14, Experiment 1a Design and Method; pp. 15–16, dependent variable and Results.
n.quote: Eighteen individuals failed an attention check and were excluded, leaving a sample of 210

notes: Only n_o assigned; other fields are unassigned null placeholders. Target matched by Experiment 1a, book browsing, activity frame and p. 16, independently of row order or numeric matching. The source explicitly states a final post-exclusion sample of 210 and assigns this sample to the factorial design. The target contrast is reported within that factorial ANOVA. N=210 is the common model participant count; separate counts for the work frame or its high/low-conflict cells are not printed in the inspected method/results/figure. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom, no cell counts were assumed, and no group sum was performed. Source version: accepted manuscript, not copyedited/typeset.
